fr1.t: French Holidays & Seasons Vocabulary Bundle | Word Search, Crossword & Bingo
fr1.h:
Get 11 French vocabulary packs in one bundle and save 30%. Holidays & Seasons: from Halloween and Christmas to Bastille Day, plus the four seasons. Each pack practices 20 essential words on one theme with no-prep printable activities: perfect for French 1, middle school, high school and immersion classes.

Themes included (11 packs, 27 pages each):

  • Halloween
  • Christmas (Noël)
  • New Year (Le Nouvel An)
  • Epiphany (L'Épiphanie)
  • Candlemas (La Chandeleur)
  • Valentine's Day (La Saint-Valentin)
  • Bastille Day (Le 14 Juillet)
  • Fall (L'automne)
  • Winter (L'hiver)
  • Spring (Le printemps)
  • Summer (L'été)

Every pack includes:

  • Vocabulary list (French with articles + English)
  • Word search with French word bank, plus a translation word search
  • Crossword with word bank and a challenge crossword (English clues, French answers)
  • Bingo: 30 different printable cards, teacher checklist and calling cards
  • Answer keys for every puzzle

Standard French as used in most U.S. textbooks. Bilingual instructions (French + English). Every word search is computer-checked so each word appears exactly once.

Great for: warm-ups, early finishers, sub plans, stations, vocabulary review, holidays and homework.

Want to try the format first? Download the FREE French Numbers pack from Letra Amable.
